question: When and how should the vidyā of the great lion-throne lady be uttered?
premises: The utterance occurs at that point in the rite.
Something is to be abandoned before uttering.
The vidyā is that of the great lion-throne lady.
inference: At that stage, having abandoned the prior element, one should utter the vidyā of the great lion-throne lady.
uncertainties: What is to be abandoned (hitvā) is not explicitly specified in this verse.
plain_english: Then, having set aside the previous element, one should utter the vidyā of the lady of the great lion throne.
